title: Women in the tribes and costume sewing
summary: Some tribes have queens, others exclude women; wives and friends help sew costumes over nine months.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Are women allowed in the tribe? What do women play?
Some tribes do have women and they have their queen and so forth And some just eliminate the women altogether
Really? Is that they don't Is there any reasoning behind?
Not that I know of They don't? Just some of them Many of them
Of course the wives probably work on the costumes

Wives usually work on the costume And many of their friends are willing to work on the costume Which is, to me, very important The fellow will do his sewing He'll have a good friend of his helping him
And this goes on This is a long period of time Almost a year Doing, you know, close to nine months of lots of sewing
